kiran_cs: LuminaCare wants a short APAC peering lift tomorrow during their migration window. They asked for CIDR allowlist + regional QPS increase. @havish_ops can you triage?

havish_ops: On it. Send the CIDRs, exact region, targeted QPS, and how long they need it. Also include a brief business reason for the change request.

kiran_cs: They provided: 203.0.113.0/25 and 203.0.113.88/32. Region: ap-southeast-2. Baseline 45 QPS -> request 280 QPS for 48 hours. Reason: bulk data sync + canary traffic to validate provider integration. They also asked if we can pre-warm their KV prefixes to reduce initial latency.

lyra_eng: I can prepare rate-limiter and allowlist changes and add an automated revoke timer at 48h. Example staging command I ran for a similar case:
```bash
redwoodctl customers patch --id lumina-care --allowlist 203.0.113.0/25,203.0.113.88 --qps 280 --region ap-southeast-2 --revoke 48h
```

havish_ops: Thanks. I'll apply to staging, run a scripted burst to 350 QPS, and verify 5xx/latency. @kiran_cs paste a sanitized prod payload for the runbook.

kiran_cs: Prod payload (sanitized):
```json
{"customer_id":"lumina-care","change":{"region":"ap-southeast-2","qps":280,"allowlist":["203.0.113.0/25","203.0.113.88/32"],"auto_revoke":"48h"},"requested_by":"kiran_cs"}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change-request created (#CS-8349) by havish_ops - awaiting infra review

lyra_eng: Staging checks passed; synthetic burst OK. Scheduling prod window in ~10m at 23:40 UTC. Watchlist: QPS, 5xx %, p99 latency, KV hit-rate. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or latency spike > baseline +80ms.

havish_ops: Deployed at 23:42 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp: 2026-03-31T23:42:00Z. CLI returned truncated JSON in runbook.

kiran_cs: Customer confirms initial sync started, error rate low (~0.08%), latency acceptable. I'll kick off KV pre-warm for top-30 prefixes and attach logs to the ticket.

maria_ae: I'll include this operational success in the renewal touch (renewal ~27 days). Share any dashboards or short clips and I'll fold them into the account narrative.

kiran_cs: Action items: 1) confirm auto-revoke executes (havish_ops), 2) publish KB for KV pre-warm + attach logs (kiran_cs), 3) AE renewal outreach (maria_ae). Leaving thread open for revoke confirmation.
